FIELD GUIDE

How the machine works
Each day harvest one of three teaching beds or four later-study beds, initially unknown. Harvest earns actual baskets and reveals that bed’s current yield; displayed history persists. Beds have public process classes (stable, depleting, recovering), but which class belongs where is initially unknown. A costly soil survey reveals process class without yielding baskets.
Spend scarce days learning a potentially superior bed or keep collecting known yield; revisit recovering beds after rest, and stop exploiting a depleting bed before it is exhausted.
Earn basket quota by the fixed final day; falling short loses naturally. Quotas are calibrated so ordinary informed choices can succeed across every allowed hidden assignment, not only lucky seeds.
